headline: UK heat de@ths hit record high of 5258 during extreme summer
label: NEWS
caption:
UK summer heat de@ths hit a record high of 5,258 in 2026 according to official estimates 🌡️

According to the UK Health Security Agency, this is the highest number of such cases since records began in 2016. The deadliest period was between June 21 and 28 when an estimated 2,401 de@ths were linked to extreme heat.

Researchers from Imperial College London and the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine also estimated that more than 50,000 heat related de@ths occurred in urban areas across 30 European countries during the summer.

Scientists say extreme heat events are becoming more frequent and intense because of climate change.
